name.baseName: Disposal, ventilation system, centralized, average for 8 m3(hm2)

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Disposal of a ventilation system for a building with a specific air flow rate of 8 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. The reference value of the inventory is 1 m2 heated gross floor area. The inventory is based on average data of 4 office buildings, 3 schools and 3 residential care homes with a total heated gross floor area of 61719 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 302190 m3/h, specific weight of the components: 14.3 kg/m2, including average components for air handling units, ducts including insulation, air valves, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers. The data represent a ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel and includes air handling units mainly with heat recovery and a nominal air flow rate of 5'000-20'000 m3/h per unit. No ground heat exchanger is included.; UUID: 01d372b7-33bc-494e-871d-7ea2c971b540

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Amount of material investigated in 2013. Disposal technology mix as used in late 1990ies

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Specific to the technology mix encountered in sorting plants in Switzerland.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Disposal to a sorting plant assumed. Metal pieces, copper in cables and electronic devices are recycled, plastic parts are incinerated, inert wastes (e.g. rock wool) are landfilled.

# Included processes
Transport to dismantling facilities, machines for handling in sorting plant, electricity demand for sorting plant, final disposal of waste material. Cut-off to recycling for metals.
